implementedWorkflow.name: script.edit
entryRoute: paste script text into the large Edit control
click OK, handle the unknown-object prompt, and repeat OK if needed
re-find the standard-button property dialog because its HWND can change
confirm, save, export, and verify script tokens

automationNotes: Opening the editor from a modal properties dialog creates another modal dialog; CLI command/click must use PostMessage or physical mouse input to avoid blocking.
Script text can be written into the large Edit control and optionally checked before OK.
When the script references an unknown object, MCGS prompts whether to add it. The workflow accepts this prompt on copied projects.
After accepting the script editor, MCGS may rebuild the parent standard-button property dialog with a new HWND. The workflow re-finds the current dialog by title before clicking confirm.
